page0.text:
I go back to my own room.
The room next to mine, separated by a single sliding door, is Saber's room.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page0:1

page1.text:
"Saber, are you awake?"
"I am. Is something the matter, Master?"
Saber slides the door open.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page1:1

page2.text:
"...Uh."
I try to get the hammering of my heart under control as she comes near.
...Calm down. I'm only going to talk to her as a Master.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page2:1

page3.text:
"Shirou. You do not look well. Has your wound opened up?"
"Uh...no, that's not it. I'm feeling all better. Actually, how are you doing?"
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page3:1

page4.text: "I am fine. It may take some more time to completely heal in my current state, but I am still well above average. I should be evenly matched in battle, so long as it is not against Berserker."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page4:1

page5.text:
I don't sense any pretension from her.
She is simply stating the truth.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page5:1

page6.text:
"..."
I don't have any response to give.
Saber's words may be encouraging to a Master, but I still don't want a delicate-looking girl like her to fight.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page6:1

page7.text: "Um...I want to ask you something. Don't you have any goals other than fighting? Since you're here in the modern world, aren't there things you'd like to do?"
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page7:1

page8.text:
"Other...goals? There is nothing else. Servants are summoned to fight, that is all.
Anything else is futile. You have raised an irrelevancy."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page8:1

page9.text:
I figured.
I'm trying to tell someone not to fight when it's their only reason for being here.
It's not that I wanted to tell her that.
But it's just that...Saber lacks humanity.
That might be enough if fighting is all she's going to do. But she is right in front of me, looking like an actual human being.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page9:1

page10.text:
So it doesn't feel right for her to just fight.
If Saber is going to be here, she should at least do something she enjoys, or it'll all seem like it was in vain.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page10:1

page11.text:
"Hey Saber. Servants are supposed to be Heroic Spirits from the past, right? Then..."
I'd been about to ask her what she was like before she became who she is now, but I stop myself.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page11:1

page12.text:
"...I cannot tell you my True Name."
During the day, Saber said that that was going to be a secret between the two of us.
So I wouldn't be surprised if Saber refused to tell me anything about her past.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page12:1

page13.text:
"Shirou? It is not polite to stop mid-sentence. If the question is important enough, I will answer."
"No...forget about it. I was just about to ask a dumb question."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page13:1

page14.text:
I avert my eyes to try to change the topic.
It really was a stupid question.
I thought I wasn't interested in Saber's identity, and Saber's been refusing to tell me because it's not safe.
Bringing up something like this would just prove I'm a bad Master, dwelling on unimportant stuff.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page14:1

page15.text:
"..."
But what else can I talk to her about, then?
If I can't ask anything about Saber, the only other topics left would be me.
...That would be even more pointless.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page15:1

page16.text:
"...Hm."
I'm grasping at straws here.
If I can't ask about her identity, I'll just have to ask about what Saber likes, what she wants to eat for breakfast tomorrow... I don't care if she's going to look at me funny. I'm ready to ask all the futile questions I want!
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page16:1

page17.text:
"Shirou. If you do not have any questions, may I ask something?"
"Eh...? Yeah, sure. What is it?"
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page17:1

page18.text: "It is about last night. You were wounded trying to save me from Berserker's attack. Do you remember that?"
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page18:1

page19.text: "I do, but...what? Are you going to keep belittling me like you had this morning? I get that it was a rash decision on my part, so don't remind me. It makes me feel sick."
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page19:1

page20.text:
"I feel the same way. But there was something I would like to ask you to help me understand you better as a person.
Shirou, why did you try to go up against Berserker?
Did you not know what would happen if you got close?"
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page20:1

page21.text:
"Well I..."
Of course I knew.
I knew getting near that thing would definitely be the end of me.
Still, I tried to save Saber not out of some foolishly optimistic belief I could.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page21:1

page22.text:
I just...tried to save her.
I didn't care about what would happen afterward.
Saving Saber was my top priority in that moment.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page22:1

page23.text:
If anything...
The fear of not being able to save Saber was greater than my fear of being killed.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page23:1

page24.text:
"Sorry, I forgot why.
It all happened so fast, so I don't really remember what I was thinking at the time. I was probably just rattled. Otherwise I wouldn't have made such a suicidal move."
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page24:1

page25.text:
Rather than tell her the truth, I just say something to try to get myself out of the situation.
I probably did it because of how seriously Saber was looking at me.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page25:1

page26.text:
"So you did it unwittingly."
"It wasn't unwitting. I told you I was rattled.
If something like that happened again, I'm sure I would just be quaking."
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page26:1

page27.text:
"You may be right. That is a normal human response. No human would throw away their own life to try to save others.
Even those who are later called heroes are no exception."
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page27:1

page28.text:
"Which is why, should I encounter such a person, I know they are lacking something.
And if that person continued to carry on in that fashion, the only thing awaiting them would be tragedy."
...
Her deep green eyes are trying to tell me something.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page28:1

page29.text:
And yet...
"Cut it out, Saber. I told you I was just frazzled. I'm scared to die too, so it's not like I can act like a saint.
If something like that happened again, I'm going to prioritize myself over you."
I try to mask my anxiety by just spouting a bunch of heartless crap.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page29:1

page30.text:
"That is a relief. If this was all a misunderstanding on my part, then there should not be an issue. Yes, you are a coward. As long as you do not choose to follow the wrong path, you should become a proper mage."
"Hey. Do I really look like a coward to you?"
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page30:1

page31.text: "Yes, very much so. Especially when you try your hardest to accept the situation in which you are placed. Do you not know that such prudence is sometimes called cowardice? It is no different than saying that one who does not know fear can never become a wise man."
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page31:1

page32.text:
She seems relieved.
Saber even smiles as she says this.
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-12:page32:1
